title: Add autonomy handoff bundle export
summary: Dirty reports summarize blocked work, but they do not contain enough content to reconstruct untracked files in another environment. Add a read-only handoff bundle command that emits the tracked patch, untracked text file contents, dirty report, and restore guidance without staging, committing, pushing, or writing Git metadata.
expectedFailureModes: A dirty handoff lists untracked files but omits their contents, making recovery incomplete.
The bundle leaks machine-local paths or private identity strings.
The bundle command mutates Git metadata while attempting to export blocked work.
nextAction: Add an autonomy handoff bundle command with JSON output, document it in autonomous workflow docs, and validate it against the current dirty tree.
